subject: Novatia technical walkthrough — Redwood inference runtime
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novatia.com>, Marc Lopez <marc.lopez@novatia.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-15T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Novatia technical walkthrough — Redwood inference runtime

Hi Ellen / Marc,

Thanks again for your time on Tuesday. Per our conversation, I set aside 45 minutes for a technical walkthrough of the Redwood inference runtime so your engineering and ML teams can see latency/cost tradeoffs, quantization options, and deployment modes (hosted vs. dedicated).

Proposed: Wed Jan 20, 11:00 AM PT — 45 min (tech deep-dive + Q&A)
Invite attached (20270115-redwood-walkthrough-invite.ics).

Agenda (high level):
- Quick intro (5 min)
- Serving runtime demonstration (15 min)
- Performance profiles & cost levers (10 min)
- Integration patterns & rollout strategies (10 min)
- Next steps & mutual action items (5 min)

If that slot doesn't work, happy to move — we can also provide a pre-recorded demo if you'd prefer. Looping in Stephanie from Sales Ops for availability and calendar handling.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: 20270115-redwood-walkthrough-invite.ics

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novatia.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marc Lopez <marc.lopez@novatia.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novatia technical walkthrough — Redwood inference runtime

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the invite and the clear agenda. I need to flag a change on our side: leadership reprioritized the roadmap last week and we are shifting focus toward a different initiative for the next quarter.

Two constraints that impact the walkthrough timing:
- Our PM lead on this evaluation (me) will be traveling Jan 22–29 and has a block of customer visits the following two weeks.
- Engineering is being pulled to finalize infra work for an enterprise customer integration, so bandwidth is limited.

Given that, we are going to pause active evaluation of third‑party inference platforms for the next ~8–10 weeks. I attached a short excerpt from our internal roadmap that highlights the shift (novatia-roadmap-notes.pdf).

Would you be open to putting this on ice and reconvening in late February / early March? I want to keep the dialog open — we liked the approach and would like to pick this back up once capacity frees up.

Apologies for the flip; priorities have been tight. If it's helpful, we can share a prioritized list of technical requirements so you can tailor a shorter follow-up when we resume.

Best,
Ellen Park
Sr. Product Manager — Platform
Novatia
ellen.park@novatia.com

----
Forwarded attachment: novatia-roadmap-notes.pdf (short internal excerpt)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-01-18T12:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novatia technical walkthrough — Redwood inference runtime

Ellen — thanks for the update and for sharing the excerpt. Totally understand — roadmap shifts happen.

Quick plan on our side:
- We'll mark the walkthrough invite as tentative and remove the hard hold from Jan 20.
- Marissa (CS) here if we want to log this as "pause but engaged" in HubSpot and set a reminder to reach out late Feb.
- If you can share a couple of must-have technical items (e.g., strict latency SLO, on‑prem requirement, or compliance constraints), we can prepare a short one‑pager tailored to Novatia to speed things up when you return.

Do you prefer we follow up on Feb 22? I can schedule a 15‑minute sync then to check status — or if your calendar is too full, we can have an automated reminder and wait for you to reach out.

We appreciate the transparency. We'll keep the deal active in the pipeline but move it to a low-touch cadence for now.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
